name: Lull Cascade
description: Let a lull tumble from one foe to the next in a cascade until a whole rank has sunk.

name: Rest Mending
description: Draw an allied company into one deep rest that mends their bodies while they lie.

name: Terror Banishing
description: Banish a lingering terror from the minds of an allied company and leave them calm.

name: Reverie Fog
description: Pour a thick fog of reverie over a rank of foes so none can tell friend from stranger.

name: Slumber Dragnet
description: Draw a dragnet of dream across a wide field that sleeps every foe it gathers.

name: Mind Sundering
description: Sunder a foe's mind from the foe's body for a time so the body drops where it stands.

name: Dream Mantle
description: Spread a mantle of dream over an allied rank that turns aside the minds of the enemy.

name: Shattered Dream
description: Shatter the shared dream of a foe's formation so the foes lose all touch with one another.

name: Vast Lullaby
description: Sing a lullaby so vast that every foe within a great hollow of sound sinks to sleep.

name: Dream Undertow
description: Pull a whole rank of foes down by a hidden undertow of dream that holds them fast.

name: Reality Drift
description: Let the waking world drift into the dream and step with a company across the gap.

name: Maestro Slumber
description: The book's signature conducting of sleep that stills a host and shelters allies with a reach scaled to the Core.

name: Mass Slumber
description: Put every mind in reach into a sleep that only the dreamer can end up to the ceiling of the dreamer's tier.
